description: Get comments under one public post: top-level comments paginated newest-first, each with its nested replies, author nickname, timestamp and comment id. Use this to see what a post is discussing or to reply to a specific comment (pass reply_to_comment_id using the id returned here). For the post body alone use get_post_detail.

post_id.description: Post id. The 8-character short id from search_posts / my_posts is enough; a link also works

name: get_post_replies
title: Get Post Replies
